title: Common definitions
description: Shared primitive shapes. Every document schema references these instead of restating them.

symbol.description: Instrument code as the app registers it, upper case.

epochMs.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC. Every timestamp in every contract uses this unit.

semverTag.description: A release tag of a producer repository. Never a branch or 'latest'.

s3Key.description: Object key without a leading slash; the bucket is configuration, not contract.

finiteNumber.description: JSON has no NaN or Infinity. A metric that is not finite is encoded as null with a reason beside it (see nullableMetric).

nullableMetric.description: A derived statistic. null means undefined for a stated reason (for example no trades), never 'unknown'.

barColumns.description: Column order of a bar in every artifact and message.

barRow.description: [t, o, h, l, c, v]. v is 0 when the source has no volume.
